# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old when first introduced  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a little lady with snow-white hair that is thick, wavy, and arranged in puffs and coils. Beneath her white hair, she possesses a girlish face with pink cheeks, sweet lips, wood-brown eyes with golden glints, and dimples. She dresses in dainty, youthfully styled gowns adorned with frills, laces, or floral patterns.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)_

## Personality

Lavendar is romantic, imaginative, and youthful at heart, possessing a soft-spoken charm and a love for pretending. Though sensible and hospitable, she is prone to sulkiness and pride when crossed. She enjoys quiet seclusion, fairy-like make-believe, and surrounding herself with sweet and cheerful things.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and fond of pretending  <sub>[v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- Proud and sulky when offended  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Hospitable and loving toward young people  <sub>[v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>
- Dislikes the thought of growing old  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at making delicious tea treats and sweet delicacies  <sub>[v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- Attentive and sympathetic listener  <sub>[v2 c27 P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

## Goals

- To stay youthful in spirit and enjoy a life of beauty and imaginative companionship  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), [v2 c23 P11](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0011)</sub>

## History

Lavendar lived a secluded, quiet life at Echo Lodge, an old stone house in Grafton built by her grandfather. After a youthful quarrel broke her engagement to Stephen Irving, she remained unmarried and occupied her time with imaginary tea parties and the woodland echoes across the river. Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon her home, quickly becoming close friends and bringing lively company back to her life. Anne later introduced Stephen's son, Paul Irving, to Lavendar, igniting her maternal feelings. Learning that Stephen was back in the area, Anne facilitated a meeting that reunited the former lovers, leading to their marriage at Echo Lodge. Following her wedding, she moved away to Boston with her husband, stepson, and handmaiden, returning to Echo Lodge for pleasant summer visits.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071), [v2 c29 P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Her father named her Lavendar because he fell in love with her mother in a room with lavender-scented sheets  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Her mother died ten years prior to Anne's visit, after which she hired the first Charlotta  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Was engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years ago before a quarrel separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m so glad you are young girls. I love young girls. It’s so easy to pretend I’m a girl myself when I’m with them. I do hate . . . to believe I’m old.  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

> Some are born old maids, some achieve old maidenhood, and some have old maidenhood thrust upon them  <sub>[v2 c23 P13](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0013)</sub>

> I always like to do things as well as possible, and since an old maid I had to be I was determined to be a very nice one.  <sub>[v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015)</sub>
